instruction: I want Chrome to ask me where to save files instead of automatically downloading them to the default folder. How do I enable this setting?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling 'Ask where to save each file before downloading' setting in Chrome. This is similar complexity to the original startup page task - both involve accessing Chrome settings and toggling a specific option.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if download prompt enabled (download.prompt_for_download=true in Preferences), 0.0 otherwise
